item.title: I hadn't written code in ten years. I built a website with Claude Code.
item.description: I can write code, but I hadn't in ten years. I work in animation, but I can't produce assets. 414 commits across 16 working days, one person, a 32-page bilingual company site. This is the working record — including the day I got stuck, what I threw away, and one solution I didn't see coming.
